svg.title: Sheet G-000 — COVER · INDEX
svg.desc: Cover sheet. Large project title Nebula Core Cluster, Root Sector, As-Built Drawing Set, drawn by Absaar IT, Principal DevSecOps and Systems Architect. A key plan of the compound with five zones. A sheet index listing G-000, A-100, A-200, A-300, A-400, A-500, D-501, S-001, R-001. General notes numbered one to eight.
